'''Rhiannon''' was once a queen of some unknown nation.

== History ==
She went to the [[White Tower]] and announced to everyone who she was. She acted very pompous and demanded something unknown from the [[Aes Sedai]]. What she received, however, was far from what she wanted.{{ref/book|7|24}}

==Legacy==
Centuries after her scene at the White Tower, a tapestry of her being humbled hangs in the corridors.{{ref/book|10|Prologue}} When [[Elayne Trakand]] boldly announces who they were to the [[Kin]], [[Nynaeve al'Meara]] chides her for it and reminds Elayne of Rhiannon.{{ref/book|7|24}}
